how_to_update: SWAPPABLE MODULE. This pack can be replaced without a new version of the program: 'ashare-cli rules-export nominees' copies it to the data folder's rules folder for editing; 'ashare-cli rules-import nominees FILE --apply' installs an edited copy after checking it (the pack it replaces is kept in rules/_replaced); 'ashare-cli rules-reset nominees --apply' returns to the pack shipped with the program. The same actions are under Check > Rules.
